'''Justin Griswold All Around Perfect''' is a [[Dark]] constructed list published on Decipher Deck Designs.

== Deck info ==
* '''Player:''' [[Justin Griswold]]
* '''Published:''' September 1996 (Decipher Deck Designs)
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - A New Hope]]
* '''Side:''' [[Dark]]
* '''Starting Card:''' {{CardLink|Death Star: Docking Bay 327|Premiere-D-deathstardockingbay327.gif}}
* '''Strategy:''' All Around Perfect
* '''GEMP Importable deck:''' [[Media:PANH All Around Perfect Griswold DS 1996.txt |Download]]

== Strategy ==

This deck was made with the Dark Side cards I have collected. I have only spent a little more than $100 on CCG and I have a created a perfect deck against almost any deck. Although it is a mostly offensive deck, it still works excellent. I have never lost a game with this deck, and only lost ONE battle with it. (I only lost by one.)

== Strategy ==

'''Introduction:''' This deck is great for any player, against any player. Most decks are based on one strategy and when played against some decks get totally crushed. That's rarely the case with this deck. The main theme of this deck is focusing on "blowing away" Yavin IV, the rebel base and overall compatability with against any deck.

'''Strategy:''' Build up a huge army at the "death star: detention block" including IT-0, and control it. Capture as many starships with characters as possible with the "deathstar tractor beam". Use "We have a prisoner" to capture characters aboard a captured starship and send them to the detention block. Then you will have huge force drains each turn until the captives are freed or the game is over.

'''Starships:''' Build up your starship army at the deathstar system and make the starship battles only occur there, with your death star tractor beam present. With 8 "Imperial class star destroyers" and the rest of your army, you'll be unstoppable. Use all 3 "Tallon Rolls" with Vader and Vaders tie, you will be able to take out almost all X-Wings and Y-wings present.

Reacting: This deck is not set up for the use of reacting against battles, just don't leave yourself vunerable anywhere and you won't need to worry about such things. This deck was designed mostly as a offensive threat.

'''Characters:''' Although there are many main chracters in this deck, if you don't have some of them, they are not that vital to the set-up of this deck. You could replace stormtroopers and other cards in place for other more hard to find, not to mention expensive cards. =)

'''Locations:''' The locations are all high force generators, with many left to permit battles (light side force bars). Deploy the Death Star as your starting location and wait for the superlaser and commence primary ignition. Use the Death Star gunners to get the superlaser and increase the total of Commence primary ignition.

'''Weapons:''' This deck has hardly any weapons. More emphasis is put on having greater power than the opponent rather than shooting at characters/starships hoping to kill them, and the tractor beams are influential in stealing the opponents starphips rather than blowing them up. And the superlaser can handle capital starship that gets in your way. A Dark Jedi lightsaber has been included to easily kill any chracter on the ground or raise force drains.

'''Used Interrupts:''' Only 2 different used interrupts in this deck, and in my opinon, the best 2 cards in the game! Trinto Duaba sends about a 25% of your opponents deck to the lost pile, without battling!! 3 are in this deck. And trinto easily knocks off any starfighter with Vader and Vaders tie combo. 3 tallon rolls are also included in this deck.

'''Lost Interrupts:''' "We have a prisoner" is a very important card in the force drain strategy at the detention block corridor. Dark Collaboration and Dark Jedi Presence both at greatly to your power, and opponents battle damage.

'''Effects:''' "Presence of the force" is needed to attack where you have no force bars, and to add to your force drains at the detention block. And Expand the empire is a great card to put on Kessel to make it cost much less to deploy starships or at cantina to increase your alien power at adjacent sites ie. place on cantina which is next to your main character base at the detention block corridor.

Overall: This deck is made for sheer power, so you don't have to worry about reacting, or watching out for rebel reacts, because they will be useless. I think this deck could be a very respectable force against any deck!! Get the cards and see if it works for you!
